verdict.rationale: The pack shows no first-party way to operate Semgrep through natural-language commands. Semgrep is driven by CLI commands (semgrep scan, semgrep ci) and YAML rules. The AI features cited (AI-Powered Detection, Semgrep Assistant post-processing of findings) apply AI to analysis, not to taking user instructions. The MCP server listing belongs to a separate agent-integration story and does not show a natural-language command interface in Semgrep itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
